criteria: Final JSON is parseable and passes current CodeTracer-compatible contract.
Referenced step/evidence IDs exist and referenced original text was actually returned.
Any inability-to-localize explanation states a concrete supported limit rather than inventing missing logs or assuming a failure.
Do not equate uninspected evidence with an absent record.
Retain supported local discrepancies while keeping unsupported causal chains empty.
Do not invent task requirements, repair status, correct answers, or original-agent stopping causes.
Distinguish successful JSON submission from correct diagnosis.
comparison: Latest two-change prompt versus original v1; no attribution to one rule in isolation.
